cat > programs/task-b1689634.py <<'PY'
def transform(grid):
    def cw(a):
        return [list(row) for row in zip(*a[::-1])]
    def ccw(a):
        return [list(row) for row in zip(*a)][::-1]
    def rot180(a):
        return [row[::-1] for row in a[::-1]]
    blocks = [grid, cw(grid), ccw(grid), rot180(grid)]
    n = len(grid)
    return [blocks[0][r] + blocks[1][r] for r in range(n)] + [blocks[2][r] + blocks[3][r] for r in range(n)]
PY
